Dudhrej

_Suni shatpragnaswami yash varmirtan, rutharej gaye sumuhit man ||_ ([unclear] — the source line is garbled)

It is stated therein that Jivanji Maharaj came to Dudhrej together with about five hundred renunciant sants (ascetic saints). At that time a miracle is also mentioned as having occurred there. All the sants and devotees [text continues on the next page]
